title: GitHub Foundations Certification: GitHub's New Developer Cert for 2026
body: GitHub launched its official certification program in 2024 with five credentials spanning the platform: GitHub Foundations (entry-level), GitHub Actions (CI/CD), GitHub Advanced Security (DevSecOps), GitHub Copilot (AI pair programming), and GitHub Administration (enterprise management). GitHub Foundations is the entry point — an approximately 75-question, 120-minute exam costing $99 USD that validates a candidate’s understanding of Git version control, GitHub repository management, pull request workflows, collaboration patterns, and the GitHub platform ecosystem. Students enrolled through GitHub Education can claim a free exam voucher via the GitHub Student Developer Pack. All badges are delivered through Credly and are valid for two years.

GitHub Foundations tests six topic areas. Git and version control fundamentals cover the distributed version control model, core Git commands (init, clone, commit, branch, merge, rebase, tag), staging areas, and remote tracking branches. Repository and collaboration features cover Issues, pull requests, code review workflows using CODEOWNERS and protected branches, GitHub Projects, and GitHub Discussions. Collaboration workflows test the fork-and-PR model for open-source contribution, the feature branch workflow for team development, and GitHub Flow for continuous deployment pipelines. GitHub Actions coverage at the Foundations level is conceptual: what workflows, events (triggers), jobs, steps, and runners are — not deep YAML configuration, which belongs to the GitHub Actions certification. The security domain covers Dependabot alerts and security updates, secret scanning, code scanning awareness, and SECURITY.md vulnerability disclosure policies. The platform features domain covers GitHub Packages, Codespaces, Copilot, Pages, Mobile, Desktop, GitHub Skills, and GitHub Education at an awareness level.

GitHub Foundations fits the DevOps certification landscape as a platform-fluency credential. Engineers studying toward CKA, AWS DVA-C02, or Azure AZ-204 use GitHub as their source control and CI/CD platform daily — GitHub Foundations formalises that knowledge with a verifiable credential. The full GitHub certification stack creates a clear DevSecOps pathway: Foundations validates platform literacy; GitHub Actions validates CI/CD pipeline engineering; GitHub Advanced Security validates supply chain security and vulnerability management. Platform engineers combining CKA with GitHub Actions target roles at $130k–$165k in North American markets in 2026, where GitHub is the primary developer portal and CI/CD entry point for Kubernetes GitOps workflows.

The fastest preparation path for GitHub Foundations is GitHub Skills — free, in-browser interactive courses that run directly inside a GitHub repository using Actions to automate instruction and feedback. Courses covering Introduction to GitHub, Review Pull Requests, Resolve Merge Conflicts, and GitHub Actions basics collectively address the majority of exam objectives. The GitHub Docs cover every feature tested on the exam. Candidates with real GitHub experience (open-source contributions, team repos with PRs and code review) typically need one to two weeks of targeted domain review rather than extended study. The exam rewards practical familiarity over memorisation: candidates who understand why workflows are structured as they are — not just how to click through the UI — consistently outperform those who only read documentation.
